title: Vibrant Tunisian Dish Bake
description: Indulge in this flavorful and spicy dish, featuring a harmonious blend of chickpeas, sweet potatoes, and cumin. Perfect for a chilly evening, this Ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is a symphony of bitter, crisp, and warm flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 tablespoon of honey, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.
Add the diced sweet potatoes and chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Spread the sweet potato and chickpea mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together 1/4 cup of chopped dates, 1/4 cup of chopped fresh parsley, and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.
After the sweet potatoes have roasted, top them with the date and parsley mixture, and a sprinkle of cumin.
Return the sweet potatoes to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the topping is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.
Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges and serve warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
To reheat, place the sweet potatoes in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until warmed through.
